env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Row O-A10: every flag that plain go gains from the logos registrations
# must stay absent from the plain `go help build` and `go help test`
# prose. The checked names are derived at run time: flagcheck.go scans
# the logos-owned registration sites and keeps the names that plain go
# accepts (a bogus value fails value validation, never flag parsing),
# so a future flag ships with a failing test instead of a stale list.
go run flagcheck.go
stdout 'hidden from plain help'

-- flagcheck.go --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
)

var callPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`(?:\.Flag\.|\bfs\.)(?:StringVar|BoolVar|Var)\(\s*[^,]+,\s*"([^"]+)"`)

func runGo(goBin string, args ...string) string {
	return runGoDir("", goBin, args...)
}

func runGoDir(dir, goBin string, args ...string) string {
	cmd := exec.Command(goBin, args...)
	cmd.Env = os.Environ()
	if dir != "" {
		cmd.Dir = dir
	}
	out, _ := cmd.CombinedOutput()
	return string(out)
}


func gained(goBin, dir, name string) bool {
	out := runGoDir(dir, goBin, "build", "-"+name+"=__w5bogus__")
	return !strings.Contains(out, "not defined")
}


func leaked(prose, name string) bool {
	if len(name) == 1 {
		pat := regexp.MustCompile(`\s-` + regexp.QuoteMeta(name) + `(?:[\s=]|$)`)
		return pat.FindStringIndex(prose) != nil
	}
	return strings.Contains(prose, name)
}

func main() {
	goroot := os.Getenv("GOROOT")
	if goroot == "" {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "no GOROOT in environment")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	files, err := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(goroot, "src", "cmd", "go", "internal", "work", "logos_*.go"))
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	files = append(files, filepath.Join(goroot, "src", "cmd", "go", "internal", "logos", "command.go"))
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	var candidates []string
	for _, path := range files {
		if strings.HasSuffix(path, "_test.go") {
			continue
		}
		data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "read %s: %v\n", path, err)
			os.Exit(2)
		}
		for _, m := range callPattern.FindAllStringSubmatch(string(data), -1) {
			if !seen[m[1]] {
				seen[m[1]] = true
				candidates = append(candidates, m[1])
			}
		}
	}
	if len(candidates) == 0 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "no logos flag registrations found")
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	goBin := os.Getenv("TESTGO_EXE")
	if goBin == "" {
		goBin = filepath.Join(goroot, "bin", "go")
	}
	plainBuild := runGo(goBin, "help", "build")
	plainTest := runGo(goBin, "help", "test")
	dir, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "flagcheck")
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	defer os.RemoveAll(dir)
	var kept, skipped []string
	for _, name := range candidates {
		if gained(goBin, dir, name) {
			kept = append(kept, name)
		} else {
			skipped = append(skipped, name)
		}
	}
	if len(kept) == 0 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "no logos flag is registered under plain go")
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	failed := false
	for _, name := range kept {
		if leaked(plainBuild, name) {
			fmt.Printf("PLAIN HELP LEAK: -%s present in go help build\n", name)
			failed = true
		}
		if leaked(plainTest, name) {
			fmt.Printf("PLAIN HELP LEAK: -%s present in go help test\n", name)
			failed = true
		}
	}
	if failed {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Printf("logos-only flags hidden from plain help: %s (logos-only: %s)\n",
		strings.Join(kept, " "), strings.Join(skipped, " "))
}
